source: GREET 2025 (Argonne National Laboratory): GREET2 material sheets, converted to ecospold2; grid electricity from GREET1 Electric sheet (full fuel cycle, at user site)
method: TRACI 2.1, applied to GREET air emissions (CO2, CH4, N2O, CO, NOx, SO2, NMVOC, PM2.5, PM10)
note: GREET has no toxic or ozone-depleting emissions, so the not_covered categories are always 0 and mean "not covered", not "no impact". Eutrophication counts NOx to air only.
